bio.b: 264 Cru is a collective of Dubai-based music heads exploring sounds from across the globe. They hosted two shows on New Delhi's boxout.fm: Booty Bangers, a UK house and bass mix series, and The Comedown, made for weekend mornings.

bio.b: Adam Rahman is an India-born techno DJ and producer based in Dubai. He was one of the early people behind Chennai's techno scene around 2000, started the Warped party series in Dubai in 2004 and runs the label KitchenSync Records. He hosted the monthly techno show WARPED on boxout.fm.

bio.b: Aeon Waves is the project of Ahmedabad-based producer and DJ Kanishk Budhori, who also works as a sound engineer. He makes drum and bass and ambient music, has released on labels including Onset Audio, Mindtrick Records and TAABIIR, and hosted the monthly drum and bass, jungle and ambient show Equal Measure on boxout.fm.

bio.b: AGENT is Smita Singh, a fashion designer, interior stylist and co-founder of Magnetic Fields Festival who lives in Goa. Raised on 80s and 90s funk, hip-hop and house, she hosted World Ocean on boxout.fm, a show of soulful, genre-hopping music from across continents.

bio.b: Amrisha Singh is a London-based DJ and radio presenter who plays eclectic, soulful and percussive music from around the world. Her long-running show A Worldwide Thing started on Delhi online station Radio 79, has been on boxout.fm since the station began, and has aired on Worldwide FM, Jazz FM and Voices Radio.

bio.b: Aneesha Kotwani is a Mumbai-based radio presenter and the founder of WAVLNGTH, a music agency she started in 2016 that works on touring, artist management, radio and content. She moved to the UK in 2009, returned to India in 2013, and has presented shows on BBC Asian Network, Soho Radio, Worldwide FM and boxout.fm.

src.fact: formed WAVLNGTH in Mumbai in 2016; agency covering radio, artist strategy, management, content; BBC Asian Network and Soho Radio shows

bio.b: Antariksh Daddy is the DJ and producer name of Anandit Sachdev, a record collector and researcher based in Delhi. He started DJing in Berlin in 2015 and, after returning to India in 2018, founded Antariksh Records, a label and community project for dance music in South Asia. He has played in Germany, Egypt and Indonesia, and released the breakbeat EP Stank Face Star Sign on Antariksh Records in 2023.

brnsctr is the producer name of Abhinav Singh, an Indian producer of experimental electronic music, named by Wild City in 2014 among Bangalore's bedroom producers. In 2016 he released the surprise ten-track album ARTLESS, and he presented the show Third Block on New Delhi's boxout.fm.

Corridors is the solo electronic project of Delhi musician Rijul Victor, who also drums for the Delhi metal band Colossal Figures. He debuted in 2016 with the single April Flows featuring Nisa Shetty, and his 2020 EP g/old moved into moody trip-hop and jazz-inspired rhythms.

D80 is the DJ and live act of Anubhav Sharma, who grew up in Delhi, spent time in Los Angeles and returned to Delhi to play disco. His DJ sets cover disco from different eras and places, his live sets use synthesisers and analogue gear, and he hosts the show Across The Universe on boxout.fm.

Daisho is the electronic music alias of designer Angad Bharaj, from Pune and now based in Bangalore. He hosted The ATYP Hour on boxout.fm and played Boxout Weekender 2018 with a set of funk, disco, world and house. His debut single Simba came out on On the Corner Records.

Dakta Dub is a Hyderabad selector and radio presenter who began DJing in 2004 in Budapest, where he hosted the show Indian Lights on Tilos Radio. Back in Hyderabad from 2008, he started Monkey Radio and the bass night Bass Sanskriti, and he hosted Dub Rituals on boxout.fm, a show of meditative dub, chillout and psychedelic ambient.

Delhi Sultanate is the stage name of Taru Dalmia, a reggae and dancehall artist from New Delhi. He is the MC and a founding member of BASSFoundation, lead singer of The Ska Vengers, and runs BFR Sound System with Begum X. On boxout.fm he hosted Dubplates And 45s, a vinyl-only show of dub and reggae.

Diggy Dang is a founding member of Reggae Rajahs, the New Delhi crew described as India's first reggae sound system, and co-founder of the ska jazz band The Ska Vengers. He works as a singer, guitarist, DJ and label manager, and has spent more than 15 years promoting reggae.

DJ MoCity was born in Baghdad and raised in New Delhi, and co-founded the online community radio station boxout.fm with Dualist Inquiry, where he hosts the show Motellacast. He also co-founded Reggae Rajahs, described as India's first reggae sound system, and the labels Dualism Records and 264 Records.

Drum Attic is a New Delhi DJ and techno producer and a core member of the boxout.fm crew. His boxout.fm show DulyUnruly explores dark takes on 4x4 techno, and he is one half of the techno duo Motion Noir.

Emote hosts Curate.love on boxout.fm, the New Delhi online community radio station, a show Wild City described as intimate soundscapes reflecting the presenter's own moods. Emote presented boxout.fm's slot on Worldwide FM's The B-Side of India series in February 2021.

EZZYLAND is the project of producer and rapper Sidharth Ezhilan, born in Salem, Tamil Nadu, who has lived in Dubai, Hyderabad and Chennai. He makes sample-built beats that mix electronic music with hip hop, and hosts ZZY on boxout.fm, a show that pairs alternative, ambient, trip-hop and trap finds with better-known tracks.

Fadescha is a DJ, artist and curator from New Delhi, working between Berlin and New Delhi, and a member of the Delhi collective Coven Code. Their DJ sets cover techno and house leaning towards acid, industrial and psychedelic sounds, and they host Party Office, an art and social space in New Delhi.

Farhan Rehman is a Mumbai DJ and producer who started producing at 16 and landed his first record on Ovum Recordings. He is the A&R and label manager of Dynamite Disco Club, the Indian disco and house label, and his sets and productions draw on afro, funk, jazz, house and disco.

FILM is New Delhi DJ and producer Sanil Sudan, who mixes house, breaks and techno and also makes dub techno as Tyrell Dub Corp. His self-titled debut album came out on Qilla Records in 2022, and his EP Miwonowi followed on Remmah. He hosted the Medium Rare show on boxout.fm and has run the Delhi venues Auro and Summer House Cafe.

bio.b: FOPCHU is an electronic band from New Delhi that started as a trio of Kaizad Nariman, Shantam Khanna and Siddhant Subs and later became a duo of Khanna and Subs. Their debut EP Milk Bred came out on boxout.fm Recordings in 2018, followed by Now Showing in 2020 and Tall Tales on Krunk Kulture in 2021.

bio.b: Inspector Maal is the project of Sahil Mendiratta, a New Delhi based producer whose music draws on the Kumaon mountains. His debut EP Fractal Spectre came out on Krunk Kulture in 2021, followed by Equal on Antariksh Records in 2023 and Namaste on Krunk Kulture in 2024. He runs Padmini Records with Nikhil Kaul.

bio.b: Kaamin is an Indian DJ and producer of melodic techno and breaks who recorded the first Hideout live set at Stakna Monastery in Ladakh in 2022. His track 'Vigil' with Sid Praja appears on Padmini Records' compilation Yaar-Dost Vol. 2 (2026).

bio.b: Kumail is Kumail Hamid, an R&B and soul producer, singer and DJ from Mumbai who is now based in Lisbon. He started with downtempo EPs and the 2016 album Links, released the album Yasmin on Bastard Jazz in 2019, and is now signed to Tru Thoughts, which released his second album Mudbrown in 2026.

bio.b: Lacuna is the solo project of Mihir Raina, a Chandigarh-born guitarist and producer who came up in Delhi and now lives in Utrecht. His music moved from glitchy trip-hop on the 2017 EP Sinking Straight to hip-hop drums and heavy bass on Skeng and Transmute, and to dubstep on the 2026 EP Light Work.

bio.b: Luna Toke is the project of Goa-based producer and selector Sachin Shetty. He hosted Magic Tea on boxout.fm, a show of South American and African grooves mixed with house and techno, and released his debut EP 'Wandering' in 2017. His SoundCloud lists him as co-founder of the Tsunami Soup collective.

bio.b: MadStarBase is a New Delhi production and DJ duo of Anant Ahuja (Ase) and Neal Sekhri. They make hip-hop and bass music built on samples and are known for bass-heavy flips of classic Bollywood songs, and they hosted MSB World on boxout.fm. In 2024 they played a set at India House during the Paris Olympics.

bio.b: MALFNKTION is the electronic project of Aditya Alamuru, a producer who came up in Bangalore's club and festival circuit and moved to Toronto in 2020. He released the EPs 'Hindustani Rascal' (2015) and 'Vote for Worms' (2016), then 'No Dough' on London's Exit Records in 2021, the first artist from India on the label. His music mixes hip-hop, bass and dubstep with Indian sounds and film samples.

bio.b: Nishant Mittal, also known as Digging In India, is a New Delhi music archivist, DJ and record store owner. He hosted the monthly show The Home And The World on boxout.fm from 2018, playing records from India and abroad, and now hosts a show on NTS Radio. In 2025 he launched the label Digging In India Records for cassette and vinyl releases and reissues.

bio.b: Oceantied is the alias of Bangalore producer and DJ Ketan Bahirat, active since 2014. He played the first Boiler Room session in India, hosted the monthly show Ripple on boxout.fm, and released the self-released footwork EP 'On The Floor Vol. 2' in 2019. He also co-founded the Bangalore collective Dasta in 2016 and plays guitar in Until We Last.

She is a resident at Worldwide FM, where she hosts Global Wav, and founded BASS WAV, a platform for women and femme DJs and artists. She has played Glastonbury, Shambala and Magnetic Fields.

bio.b: Profound is a hip-hop and electronic producer from Chandigarh, based in New Delhi. His debut EP Returning Rituals came out with KRUNK in 2015 and the beat tape fre$h on Knowmad Records in 2017. He played the first Boxout Weekender in 2018 as a Boxout.fm Recordings artist.

bio.b: Rajah Betta is a DJ, producer and radio host born in Bombay who developed his sound in New York, where he hosted Betta Sounds on Brooklyn's Newtown Radio, before moving back to India in 2025. He calls his blend of club music and Bombay samples "Bombay Club". In 2026 he appeared on Padmini Records' Yaar-Dost vol. 2 and released the two-track EP Offcuts on Stereo Ferment.

bio.b: Reggae Rajahs are a reggae sound system of DJs and MCs from New Delhi, formed in 2009 by DJ MoCity, Diggy Dang and Mr Herbalist, who play dub, reggae and dancehall. They ran the weekly show Pressure Drop, later on boxout.fm, started Goa Sunsplash in 2016 and have played Rototom Sunsplash, Sziget and Outlook in Europe.

bio.b: Sarathy Korwar is a percussionist and composer born in the US, raised in India and based in London. He blends Indian classical and folk traditions with jazz and electronics, on albums including Day To Day (Ninja Tune, 2016), More Arriving (The Leaf Label, 2019) and KALAK (The Leaf Label, 2022). He hosted the monthly boxout.fm show Endangered Species and played Boxout Weekender 2019 in New Delhi.

bio.b: Varun Desai is a Kolkata-based DJ, producer, label head and educator who records as Yidam and 5volts. He started the label Liquid Frequency, which releases electronic and ambient music by Indian acts, set up the Social Isolation ambient compilations during lockdown, and runs the synthesizer residency Synthfarm. On boxout.fm he hosted Tropickle, a show of South American sounds, Bengali folk and electro-cumbia.

bio.b: Yidam is the ambient and downtempo project of Kolkata producer Varun Desai. It started with roots in dub and psy-ambient and later took in live electronic jams with jazz musicians; his 2018 Wild City mix was dedicated to Berlin school music and outer space. Yidam played Boxout Weekender in 2018 and appears on Nādāsana's ambient compilation Inter-Galactic Sonar Communication Probe Vol. 1 (2022).

bio.b: Zequenx is a DJ, producer and Ableton Certified Trainer, born in Kashmir and raised in Chiang Mai, who came up in New Delhi as a member of the collective Coven Code and now works between Goa and New Delhi. Sets run from acid and electro to dark, psychedelic techno, alongside ambient live sets. Releases include tracks on FOL Records, Regenerate and Qilla Records, and festival dates include Boxout Weekender, Magnetic Fields and Montreux Jazz Festival.
